# Event catalog

<!-- Generated by `uv run python -m riven_schemas.catalog > docs/events.md`. Do not edit. -->

Schema version **1**. Events are written to the transactional outbox in the same database transaction as the state change, relayed to the Redis Stream `riven:events`, and delivered at least once. Consumers deduplicate on `event_id`.

| Event | Producer | Consumers | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`change.captured`](#changecaptured) | capture | orchestrator, graph | A commit or PR was captured, with the identity that produced it. |
| [`verification.completed`](#verificationcompleted) | orchestrator | memory, graph | A verification run finished with a verdict from an independent verifier. |
| [`bug.confirmed`](#bugconfirmed) | memory | graph | A failure was confirmed as a bug and stored in bug memory. |
| [`regression.detected`](#regressiondetected) | memory | graph | A previously fixed bug came back: its regression lock failed on a new change. |
| [`lock.created`](#lockcreated) | memory | graph | A fixed bug now has a regression lock guarding it. |
